question:
Select the option with the correct spelling to replace the underlined word in the given sentence.

Polluted air can be __dangeros__, even if the pollutants are invisible.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dangeros"** is misspelled and should be corrected to "dangerous". (खतरनाक)

 
 
• **Example:** Swimming in the ocean during a storm can be very dangerous.
 
 

 
• **"Dangerous"** means able or likely to cause harm or injury. (खतरनाक)

 
 
• **Example:** The road conditions were dangerous due to the heavy rain.
 
 

 
• Thus, the correct spelling for the word in the context of the sentence is **"dangerous"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dangerus** (खतरनाक): This is an incorrect spelling of "dangerous".

 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 

 
• **Dangeres** (खतरनाक): This is an incorrect spelling of "dangerous".

 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 

 
• **Dangeris** (खतरनाक): This is an incorrect spelling of "dangerous".

 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 

Question: Polluted air can be dangeros, even if the pollutants are invisible.

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
